cards.name: Everyone's Idol
cards.text:
For the next 7 Rhythm Cards activated, increase Damage Amount of Rhythm Cards by 7%.
If activated 7 times, add 1 Hit to the next 7 Rhythm Cards activated.

cards.name: Sound Check
cards.text: 100% Damage.

cards.name: Fan Service
cards.text: Heal 100%.

cards.name: Music, Start!
cards.text:
Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards.
Create and give each ally 2 of their own Rhythm in Draw Pile.
Apply Haste to Rhythm cards of this unit.

cards.name: Music, Start! I
cards.text:
Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards.
Create and give each ally 2 of their own Rhythm: Crescendo in Draw Pile.
Apply Haste to Rhythm cards of this unit.

cards.name: Music, Start! II
cards.text:
Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards.
Create and give each ally 2 of their own Rhythm: Staccato in Draw Pile.
Apply Haste to Rhythm cards of this unit.

cards.name: Music, Start! III
cards.text:
Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards.
Create and give each ally 2 of their own Rhythm: Fortissimo in Draw Pile.
Apply Haste to Rhythm cards of this unit.

cards.name: Music, Start! IV
cards.text:
Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards.
Create and give each ally 2 of their own Rhythm: Fermata in Draw Pile.

cards.name: Music, Start! V
cards.text:
Exhaust all Basic Attack Cards.
Create 1 of each Rhythm: Arpeggio in Draw Pile.

cards.name: Spotlight
cards.text:
140% Damage.
Move 1 Rhythm Card to hand.
Decrease Cost of that card by 2 until activated.

cards.name: Spotlight I
cards.text:
210% Damage.
Move 2 Rhythm card(s) to hand.
Decrease Cost of 1 of those cards by 2 until activated.

cards.name: Spotlight II
cards.text: When 3 Rhythm cards are activated in a turn, create 1 Spotlight with Exhaust and decrease Cost of those cards by 1 (1 time per turn).

cards.name: Spotlight III
cards.text:
350% Damage.
Select and move up to 2 Rhythm cards to hand, then activate those cards

cards.name: Spotlight IV
cards.text:
Select up to 3 Rhythm cards from among Draw Pile or Graveyard and move those cards to the top of Draw Pile.
Draw 1 of those cards.

cards.name: Spotlight V
cards.text:
140% Damage.
Draw 2 of those cards.
Discard all non-Rhythm cards.

cards.name: Call & Response
cards.text:
200% damage.
If in hand, also treat as a Rhythm card.
Attunement: Draw 1 Rhythm card.

cards.name: Call & Response I
cards.text:
250% Damage.
If in hand, treat as a Rhythm card.
Attunement: Draw 2 Rhythm card(s).

cards.name: Call & Response II
cards.text:
240% Damage × 2.
If in Draw Pile or in hand, activate this card when a Rhythm card is activated.

cards.name: Call & Response III
cards.text:
Draw 2 Rhythm card(s).
If in Draw Pile, activate this card when a Rhythm card is activated.

cards.name: Call & Response IV
cards.text:
120% Damage.
When a Rhythm card is activated, add 1 Hit to this card (max 5).

cards.name: Call & Response V
cards.text:
700% Damage.
If in hand, treat as a Rhythm card. When a Rhythm card is activated, decrease Cost of this card by 1 until this card is activated.

cards.name: Encore
cards.text:
120% Damage.
If the last card activated was a Rhythm card, activate that card.

cards.name: Encore I
cards.text:
120% Damage.
If the last card activated was a Rhythm card, activate that card 2 times

cards.name: Encore II
cards.text: For every 2 Rhythm cards activated, 100% Damage to the enemy with the lowest HP (15 times per turn).

cards.name: Encore III
cards.text: For the next 3 Rhythm card(s) activated, decrease Cost by 1 and add 1 Hit.

cards.name: Encore IV
cards.text: Activate all Rhythm cards in Graveyard.

cards.name: Encore V
cards.text:
Draw 1.
If that card was a Rhythm card, increase Damage Amount by 100% until activated for 1 turn and repeat 1 more time (max 2 times).

cards.name: Photo Time
cards.text:
1 Performance Buzz.
If a Rhythm card was activated or moved to hand, increase Performance Buzz of this card by 1 until activated (max 9 times).

cards.name: Rhythm
cards.text:
60% Damage.
+30% Damage Amount for each Rhythm activated in hand.

cards.name: Rhythm: Crescendo
cards.text:
180% Damage.
+40% Damage Amount for each Rhythm in Graveyard; for 1 turn, decrease Cost of the next Rhythm card activated by 1.

cards.name: Rhythm: Staccato
cards.text:
80% Damage.
+50% Damage Amount for each Rhythm; if the last card activated was a Rhythm card, increase Cost by 1.

cards.name: Rhythm: Fortissimo
cards.text:
90% Damage.
+55% Damage Amount for each Linked Rhythm before activation; when 3 or more cards are Linked, add 1 Hit.

cards.name: Rhythm: Fermata
cards.text: Select 1 of 4 Rhythm cards, change all Rhythm cards into the selected card for 1 turn, and draw 2 of them.

cards.name: Rhythm: Arpeggio
cards.text:
15% Damage for each Rhythm.
Draw 1 of the lowest-Cost Rhythm cards and decrease Cost by 1 until activated.

cards.name: Rhythm: Arpeggio
cards.text:
20% Damage for each Rhythm.
Draw 2 of the lowest-Cost Rhythm cards and decrease Cost by 1 until activated.

cards.name: Rhythm: Arpeggio
cards.text:
40% Damage for each Rhythm.
Activate 1 of the highest-Cost Rhythm cards in hand.

cards.name: Rhythm: Arpeggio
cards.text:
50% Damage for each Rhythm.
Activate 1 Rhythm card(s) with the highest Cost from among Draw Pile or Discard Pile.

cards.name: Rhythm: Arpeggio
cards.text:
80% Damage for each Rhythm.
Decrease Cost of this card by 1 for each Rhythm card in Graveyard.

cards.name: Rhythm: Arpeggio
cards.text:
90% Damage for each Rhythm.
Decrease Cost of this card by 1 for each Rhythm card activated this turn.

cards.name: Photo Card
cards.text: 2 Ego Points.
